data.narrative:
Bedrock Ocean is a Series A-stage ocean and maritime technology company founded by Anthony DiMare and Charles Chiau. The company has raised $63M to date. The comparable universe for this valuation consists of two private peers—Seasats and Havoc AI—reflecting the nascent state of the frontier ocean-tech sector; no public comparables exist in this space.

Valuation analysis relies on a stage-progression methodology, which is applicable given Bedrock's Series A positioning. Using total capital raised ($63M) as a proxy for current value, a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A-to-subsequent-stage step-ups yields an implied valuation of $126M. This single-method approach anchors the analysis, though the limited comparable universe constrains triangulation depth.

The valuation range supported by this analysis spans $107M (low) to $145M (high), with a median of $126M. The relatively narrow band reflects reliance on one primary method rather than true triangulation across independent approaches. Key uncertainties include the absence of public market benchmarks for ocean-tech ventures, limited visibility into the two private peers' recent financing terms, and broader questions about capital deployment efficiency and path to revenue maturity in this emerging sector. Additional diligence on unit economics and market-size assumptions would strengthen conviction in this range.
